ambiguities: A2.3 Numeracy could be argued from lab-value and enrollment-count reasoning ('about four patients behind target', 'forty hours', 'one enrollee'), but the interview does not show active calculation or quantitative analysis beyond citing counts, so it was not assigned as a standalone category; treat as weak/borderline.
